377def _collapse_dims(shape, stride): 

378 """Fold memory-adjacent dimensions together, preserving flat-index order. 

379 

380 `put_` addresses `self` by its flattened (row-major) index, so any group of 

381 trailing dimensions that is contiguous in memory can be treated as one 

382 dimension without changing which element a flat index names. This turns a 

383 contiguous tensor of any rank into rank 1 and keeps the in-kernel decode 

384 within MAX_UNROLL_RANK for every realistic layout. 

385 """ 

386 new_shape, new_stride = [], [] 

387 for d in reversed(range(len(shape))): 

388 if shape[d] == 1: 

389 # A size-1 dimension contributes a constant 0 to the offset. 

390 continue 

391 if new_shape and new_stride[-1] * new_shape[-1] == stride[d]: 

392 new_shape[-1] *= shape[d] 

393 else: 

394 new_shape.append(shape[d]) 

395 new_stride.append(stride[d]) 

396 new_shape.reverse() 

397 new_stride.reverse() 

398 return new_shape, new_stride

401def _is_non_overlapping_and_dense(t): 

402 """Mirror of `TensorImpl::is_non_overlapping_and_dense()`.""" 

403 if t.is_contiguous(): 

404 return True 

405 sizes_strides = sorted((s, sz) for sz, s in zip(t.shape, t.stride()) if sz != 1) 

406 expected = 1 

407 for stride, size in sizes_strides: 

408 if stride != expected: 

409 return False 

410 expected *= size 

411 return True 

412 

413 

414def _has_internal_overlap(t): 

415 """Mirror of `at::has_internal_overlap()`: MemOverlap::{No,Yes,TooHard}.""" 

416 if _is_non_overlapping_and_dense(t): 

417 return "no" 

418 # A zero stride on a dimension of size > 1 aliases the same element. 

419 for size, stride in zip(t.shape, t.stride()): 

420 if size > 1 and stride == 0: 

421 return "yes" 

422 return "too_hard" 

423 

424 

425def _overlap_status(a, b): 

426 """Mirror of `c10::get_overlap_status()`: Full / Partial / No / TooHard.""" 

427 if a is b: 

428 return "full" 

429 if a.numel() == 0 or b.numel() == 0: 

430 return "no" 

431 if not _is_non_overlapping_and_dense(a) or not _is_non_overlapping_and_dense(b): 

432 return "too_hard" 

433 if a.untyped_storage().data_ptr() != b.untyped_storage().data_ptr(): 

434 return "no" 

435 a_begin, b_begin = a.data_ptr(), b.data_ptr() 

436 a_end = a_begin + a.numel() * a.element_size() 

437 b_end = b_begin + b.numel() * b.element_size() 

438 if a_begin == b_begin and a_end == b_end: 

439 # Identical byte range: only a matching layout means element-wise identity. 

440 return "full" if a.stride() == b.stride() else "partial" 

441 if a_begin < b_end and b_begin < a_end: 

442 return "partial" 

443 return "no" 

444

446def _assert_no_internal_overlap(t): 

447 """`at::assert_no_internal_overlap` -- rejects e.g. an expanded `self`.""" 

448 if _has_internal_overlap(t) == "yes": 

449 raise RuntimeError( 

450 "unsupported operation: more than one element of the written-to tensor " 

451 "refers to a single memory location. Please clone() the tensor before " 

452 "performing the operation." 

453 )

456def _check_and_unalias(written_to, other): 

457 """Apply ATen's overlap rules to a read-only operand, in a single pass. 

458 

459 ATen raises for a Full/Partial overlap status but deliberately permits 

460 `TooHard` (either operand non-dense, e.g. `self=t[::2]`, `source=t[1::2]`), 

461 where byte ranges interleave without sharing elements. Its element-at-a-time 

462 CUDA kernel tolerates that; ours would read and write the same bytes 

463 concurrently and race, so snapshot the operand instead -- the pre-operation 

464 values are exactly what ATen computes. 

465 """ 

466 status = _overlap_status(written_to, other) 

467 if status in ("full", "partial"): 

468 raise RuntimeError( 

469 "unsupported operation: some elements of the input tensor and the " 

470 "written-to tensor refer to a single memory location. Please clone() " 

471 "the tensor before performing the operation." 

472 ) 

473 if status == "too_hard": 

474 return other.clone() 

475 return other

478def _flatten(t): 

479 """Contiguous 1-D view of `t`, in flattened (row-major) element order.""" 

480 if t.ndim == 1 and t.is_contiguous(): 

481 return t 

482 return t.contiguous().reshape(-1)

485def _launch(inp, index_flat, source_flat, accumulate): 

486 """Launch `put_kernel` over an already-validated, already-flat triple.""" 

487 N = index_flat.numel() 

488 inp_numel = inp.numel() 

489 

490 if inp.is_contiguous(): 

491 # The overwhelmingly common case: the flat index *is* the element 

492 # offset, so skip dim collapsing entirely and let the kernel skip the 

493 # decode too. Worth special-casing because at small N this operator is 

494 # dominated by host-side launch preparation. 

495 shape, stride, rank = [inp_numel], [1], 1 

496 else: 

497 shape, stride = _collapse_dims(list(inp.shape), list(inp.stride())) 

498 rank = len(shape) 

499 

500 has_precomputed = rank > MAX_UNROLL_RANK 

501 dyn_rank = rank if has_precomputed else 0 

502 if has_precomputed: 

503 # A >MAX_UNROLL_RANK collapsed layout (a heavily permuted high-rank 

504 # view). Hand the kernel the layout vector (sizes then strides) and let 

505 # it decode in a loop, so no offsets are computed on the host and no 

506 # extra device launches precede the scatter. 

507 layout_arg = torch.tensor(shape + stride, dtype=torch.int64, device=inp.device) 

508 else: 

509 # Unused on this path; pass `inp` so no allocation happens at all. 

510 layout_arg = inp 

511 

512 # Pad to exactly MAX_UNROLL_RANK. Truncation only ever applies on the 

513 # precomputed-offsets path, where these arguments are unused -- padding 

514 # without truncating would push extra positionals into the constexprs. 

515 shape = (shape + [1] * MAX_UNROLL_RANK)[:MAX_UNROLL_RANK] 

516 stride = (stride + [0] * MAX_UNROLL_RANK)[:MAX_UNROLL_RANK] 

517 

518 # This kernel is a pure scatter: one load and one store per index, no reuse 

519 # and no cross-lane communication. It is bound by memory latency and, at 

520 # small N, by launch overhead -- measured block/warp sweeps showed no 

521 # difference, so keep a single fixed configuration. 

522 BLOCK_SIZE, num_warps = 1024, 4 

523 grid = (triton.cdiv(N, BLOCK_SIZE),) 

524 

525 with torch_device_fn.device(inp.device): 

526 put_kernel[grid]( 

527 inp, 

528 index_flat, 

529 source_flat, 

530 layout_arg, 

531 inp_numel, 

532 N, 

533 *shape, 

534 *stride, 

535 RANK=rank if not has_precomputed else 0, 

536 IS_ACCUMULATE=accumulate, 

537 IS_CONTIGUOUS=(rank == 1 and stride[0] == 1), 

538 HAS_PRECOMPUTED_OFFSETS=has_precomputed, 

539 RANK_DYN=dyn_rank, 

540 BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE, 

541 num_warps=num_warps, 

542 )

545def _stage_layout(src): 

546 """Layout vector + launch geometry decoding ``src``'s flat logical order. 

547 

548 Shared by the widen and narrow staging kernels: ``put_`` addresses the 

549 *row-major flattening* of the tensor, so every flat offset has to be turned 

550 into a real element address with this decomposition whenever the tensor is 

551 not contiguous. 

552 """ 

553 N = src.numel() 

554 if src.is_contiguous(): 

555 shape, stride, rank = [N], [1], 1 

556 else: 

557 shape, stride = _collapse_dims(list(src.shape), list(src.stride())) 

558 rank = len(shape) 

559 has_precomputed = rank > MAX_UNROLL_RANK 

560 dyn_rank = rank if has_precomputed else 0 

561 if has_precomputed: 

562 layout_arg = torch.tensor(shape + stride, dtype=torch.int64, device=src.device) 

563 else: 

564 # Unused on this path; pass `src` so no allocation happens at all. 

565 layout_arg = src 

566 shape = (shape + [1] * MAX_UNROLL_RANK)[:MAX_UNROLL_RANK] 

567 stride = (stride + [0] * MAX_UNROLL_RANK)[:MAX_UNROLL_RANK] 

568 return layout_arg, shape, stride, rank, has_precomputed, dyn_rank 

569 

570 

571def _stage_to_int32(src, bool_normalize=False): 

572 """Device-side widen of ``src`` into a contiguous int32 buffer. 

573 

574 The staging buffer holds ``src``'s values in row-major logical order, which 

575 is the order ``put_`` indexes ``self`` in. ``src`` may be a strided view, so 

576 the read decodes the flat offset against its real strides -- reading it as 

577 contiguous storage would pick up the wrong elements. 

578 """ 

579 out = torch.empty(src.numel(), dtype=torch.int32, device=src.device) 

580 N = out.numel() 

581 if N == 0: 

582 return out 

583 layout_arg, shape, stride, rank, has_precomputed, dyn_rank = _stage_layout(src) 

584 BLOCK_SIZE = 1024 

585 put_stage_widen_kernel[(triton.cdiv(N, BLOCK_SIZE),)]( 

586 out, 

587 src, 

588 layout_arg, 

589 N, 

590 *shape, 

591 *stride, 

592 TO_BOOL=bool_normalize, 

593 RANK=rank if not has_precomputed else 0, 

594 IS_CONTIGUOUS=(rank == 1 and stride[0] == 1), 

595 HAS_PRECOMPUTED_OFFSETS=has_precomputed, 

596 RANK_DYN=dyn_rank, 

597 BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE, 

598 num_warps=4, 

599 ) 

600 return out 

601 

602 

603def _stage_back(dst, staged, to_bool=False): 

604 """Device-side narrow of a contiguous int32 ``staged`` back into ``dst``. 

605 

606 ``staged`` holds ``dst``'s values in row-major logical order, which is the 

607 order ``put_`` indexes ``self`` in -- but ``dst`` itself may be a strided 

608 view, so the narrowing store decodes the flat offset against ``dst``'s real 

609 strides (the same layout handling ``_launch`` uses for the scatter). 

610 """ 

611 N = staged.numel() 

612 if N == 0: 

613 return dst 

614 layout_arg, shape, stride, rank, has_precomputed, dyn_rank = _stage_layout(dst) 

615 BLOCK_SIZE = 1024 

616 put_stage_narrow_kernel[(triton.cdiv(N, BLOCK_SIZE),)]( 

617 dst, 

618 staged, 

619 layout_arg, 

620 N, 

621 *shape, 

622 *stride, 

623 TO_BOOL=to_bool, 

624 RANK=rank if not has_precomputed else 0, 

625 IS_CONTIGUOUS=(rank == 1 and stride[0] == 1), 

626 HAS_PRECOMPUTED_OFFSETS=has_precomputed, 

627 RANK_DYN=dyn_rank, 

628 BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE, 

629 num_warps=4, 

630 ) 

631 return dst 

632 

633 

634def _put_impl(inp, index, source, accumulate=False): 

635 inp_numel = inp.numel() 

636 

637 # Flatten index/source so each program handles one (index, source) pair. 

638 # `.contiguous()` must come *before* `reshape(-1)`: on an already-1-D 

639 # strided view (`idx[::2]`) `reshape(-1)` is a no-op that preserves the 

640 # non-unit stride, and the kernel reads with unit stride -- silently 

641 # scattering the wrong values. `_flatten` skips both calls when the operand 

642 # is already a contiguous 1-D tensor, which is the common case. 

643 index_flat = _flatten(index) 

644 source_flat = _flatten(source) 

645 

646 if index_flat.numel() == 0: 

647 # Nothing to scatter. ATen still validates (above) but performs no write, 

648 # including when `self` itself is empty. 

649 return inp 

650 

651 if inp_numel == 0: 

652 raise IndexError("put_(): Tried to put elements into an empty tensor") 

653 

654 dtype = inp.dtype 

655 

656 if dtype.is_complex: 

657 # Triton has no complex type. A complex tensor is an interleaved 

658 # (real, imag) pair, so `view_as_real` gives two strided real views that 

659 # `put_` can scatter independently -- the flat index of a complex 

660 # element is the flat index of both its components. 

661 real_view = torch.view_as_real(inp) 

662 re, im = real_view[..., 0], real_view[..., 1] 

663 src_real = torch.view_as_real(source_flat) 

664 _launch(re, index_flat, src_real[..., 0].contiguous(), accumulate) 

665 _launch(im, index_flat, src_real[..., 1].contiguous(), accumulate) 

666 return inp 

667 

668 if accumulate and dtype in _NARROW_INT_DTYPES: 

669 # Triton has no atomic_add for int8/uint8/int16 (and none for bool). 

670 # Accumulate into an int32 staging buffer, then narrow back. Both the 

671 # widen and the narrow run as Triton kernels: the narrowing store wraps 

672 # exactly like native's integer accumulate. 

673 staged = _stage_to_int32(inp) 

674 _launch(staged, index_flat, _stage_to_int32(source_flat), True) 

675 _stage_back(inp, staged) 

676 return inp 

677 

678 if accumulate and dtype is torch.bool: 

679 # `accumulate=True` on bool is a logical OR in native (measured: any 

680 # True source lands as True, an already-True slot stays True). int32 

681 # atomic_add then a `!= 0` narrow reproduces it without a bool atomic. 

682 staged = _stage_to_int32(inp, bool_normalize=True) 

683 _launch( 

684 staged, index_flat, _stage_to_int32(source_flat, bool_normalize=True), True 

685 ) 

686 _stage_back(inp, staged, to_bool=True) 

687 return inp 

688 

689 _launch(inp, index_flat, source_flat, accumulate) 

690 return inp 

691 

692 

693def put_(inp, index, source, accumulate=False): 

694 logger.debug("GEMS PUT_") 

695 

696 # Validation order mirrors ATen: device, then index dtype, then source 

697 # dtype, then numel, then the memory-overlap checks. Measured against 

698 # `torch.Tensor.put_` on inputs that violate two rules at once. 

699 if index.device != inp.device or source.device != inp.device: 

700 bad, name = ( 

701 (index, "index") if index.device != inp.device else (source, "source") 

702 ) 

703 raise RuntimeError( 

704 f"Expected all tensors to be on the same device, but got {name} is " 

705 f"on {bad.device}, different from other tensors on {inp.device} " 

706 "(when checking argument in method wrapper_CUDA__put_)" 

707 ) 

708 if index.dtype != torch.int64: 

709 raise RuntimeError( 

710 "put_(): Expected a long tensor for index, but got " 

711 f"{_SCALAR_TYPE_NAMES.get(index.dtype, str(index.dtype))}" 

712 ) 

713 if source.dtype != inp.dtype: 

714 raise RuntimeError( 

715 "put_(): self and source expected to have the same dtype, but got " 

716 f"self.dtype = {_SCALAR_TYPE_NAMES.get(inp.dtype, str(inp.dtype))} " 

717 f"and source.dtype = " 

718 f"{_SCALAR_TYPE_NAMES.get(source.dtype, str(source.dtype))}" 

719 ) 

720 if index.numel() != source.numel(): 

721 raise IndexError( 

722 "put_(): Expected source and index to have the same number of elements, " 

723 f"but got source.numel() = {source.numel()}, index.numel() = {index.numel()}" 

724 ) 

725 if inp.dtype == torch.complex32: 

726 # Native CUDA `put_` has no ComplexHalf kernel 

727 # (`put_cuda`/`take_put_cpu` both raise NotImplementedError) and Triton 

728 # cannot represent complex32 either. Reject it explicitly so the failure 

729 # matches ATen instead of silently routing through the FP16 real-view path. 

730 raise NotImplementedError( 

731 '"put_cuda" not implemented for ' 

732 f"'{_SCALAR_TYPE_NAMES.get(torch.complex32, 'ComplexHalf')}'" 

733 ) 

734 

735 _assert_no_internal_overlap(inp) 

736 index = _check_and_unalias(inp, index) 

737 source = _check_and_unalias(inp, source) 

738 

739 return _put_impl(inp, index, source, accumulate)
